title.value: GAUCHE: A Library for Gaussian Processes in Chemistry
title.justification: The title specifies the introduction of an open-source library focused on Gaussian processes in chemistry, aligning with the content and goals described within the paper.
title.quote: We introduce GAUCHE, an open-source library for GAUssian processes in CHEmistry.

extractions.description: GAUCHE is an open-source library designed to provide Gaussian processes tailored for chemistry. The library offers modular and user-friendly components to facilitate Bayesian optimization and uncertainty quantification, enabling efficient molecular discovery, chemical reaction optimization, and protein design. By integrating robust kernels for molecular representations, GAUCHE supports scientific experts in utilizing state-of-the-art probabilistic modeling in real-world chemistry applications.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: While the library has applications in chemistry and materials science, there is no direct or explicit focus on climate change or ecological sustainability within the paper's description and goals.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Motivated by scenarios frequently encountered in practice, we showcase applications for GAUCHE in molecular discovery, chemical reaction optimisation and protein design.
